description: This source file defines the EngineState class, which manages communication and state representation for an engine control system within the rusefi project. It handles parsing responses, managing actions keyed by strings, and notifying listeners about engine state updates.

classes.name: EngineState
classes.description: Manages engine state data, response parsing, and communication callbacks, supporting listeners for time and key-value updates.

classes.name: EngineState.EngineStateListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to engine state events such as line processing and key-value updates.

classes.name: EngineState.ValueCallback
classes.description: Generic callback interface for handling string value updates.

classes.name: EngineState.StringActionPair
classes.description: Internal class pairing a string key with its associated callback, also storing a lowercase prefix.

methods.name: replaceStringValueAction
methods.description: Replaces an existing string value action or adds a new one for the given key.

methods.name: packString
methods.description: Packages a string into a length-prefixed format for transmission.

methods.name: unpackString
methods.description: Extracts the string content from a length-prefixed message, ensuring message integrity.

methods.name: handleResponse
methods.description: Processes a response string, dispatching key-value pairs to registered actions.

methods.name: handleStringActionPair
methods.description: Handles a specific string key and value pair within a response string.

methods.name: startWithIgnoreCase
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with a given prefix, ignoring case for letters.

methods.name: registerStringValueAction
methods.description: Registers a new callback action for a specific string key.

methods.name: removeAction
methods.description: Removes all registered callbacks associated with a specific key.

methods.name: processNewData
methods.description: Appends new data to the response buffer and processes it.
